nodes.title: Tilt-board tip-over angles
nodes.procedure: Built aircraft, props off, pack in (then pack slid to the forward stop, then pack out), on a 0.6 x 0.8 m plywood board faced with the landing-mat rubber, a 6 mm stop strip behind the pads on the hinge side. Raise the far edge slowly with a phone inclinometer on the board; record the angle when the far pads lift. Four directions (+z pod side, -z, +y, -y), 3 times each. Pass: pod side >= 30 deg and within 1.5 deg of CL-C5-TIPOVER-R1 (else re-measure the CG z).

nodes.title: Touchdown drift and spool-down from logs
nodes.procedure: H2: 20 QLAND / QLOITER landings of the twin, then of the aircraft; from the dataflash log take the EKF ground speed at first contact (accel spike) and the time from contact to all motors at spin-min. Pass: 95th percentile ground speed <= 0.3 m/s; throttle out <= 0.71 hover within 0.5 s of contact.

nodes.title: Single-foot drop rig
nodes.procedure: A foot (shoe bonded on a 2-layer foam-board offcut clamped vertical) under a 0.65 kg sled on two guide rods; free drop 0.115 m onto plywood; phone or logger accelerometer on the sled. 3 drops, new cartridge each. Pass: stroke <= 35 mm (model 26 mm), sled peak <= 6.0 g (100 Hz filter), no shoe-bond crack. With the biased, pre-crushed cartridges (CR-C5-10, R3) use a 0.69 kg sled for an upper-foot cartridge and 0.61 kg for a lower one (quarter gate mass x bias). Run before the aircraft drop; cheap and repeatable.

nodes.title: Aircraft drop (= T-C1-FOOT-DROP), proposed foot
nodes.procedure: Complete aircraft, props off, LiPo replaced by a sandbag of the weighed pack mass (ballast to 2.6 kg), FC on a small 2S pack logging IMU at >= 1 kHz. Quick-release hook over plywood. (1) Level, 0.115 m pad-to-floor, x2, new cartridges each: pass CG peak <= 6.0 g (100 Hz low-pass), every stroke <= 35 mm, each pair's stroke within 3 mm of the model (the R3 bias leaves the upper pair ~3 mm deeper by design). (2) Pitch 4 deg both ways and roll 8 deg, at 0.098 m (CL-C5-TEST-TILT-H): pass when each pair's stroke is within 3 mm of the model re-run at the measured height and tilt, and the wing TE stays clear except the wingtip corner cap. The model then carries the design case (1.5 m/s with 2/3 W lift). After every drop: shoe bonds, fin tips, tube block and pod bond checked.

nodes.title: Crush block ahead of the pack (5 m/s nose-in), D-62 bay (nose -0.140 m), D-64 packs
nodes.equation: per weighed pack mass m (546 / 551 / 590 g, D-64) at its D-62 station x_p (flight-card mark) and at the C5 trim to the D-62 target: F = min(n_pack m g, sigma A_bay) ; KE = m v^2 / 2 ; eff = eps_d - eps_y / 2 ; nose wall inside face x_n = x_le + t_nose ; block A L_A = nose_block_l_m ; forward stop (t_stop, h_stop, w = fwd_stop_m) aft face x_s = x_n + L_A + t_stop ; block B fills x_s .. pack fore face behind a t_sp spreader ; capacities add: gap_B needed = t_sp + max(0, KE - F_A eff L_A) / (F eff), F_A = min(F, sigma A_stop) ; full-section stop A_stop = A_bay ; D2's stop as drawn A_stop = h_stop w ; margin = (x_p - L_pack/2 - x_s) - gap_B needed ; most forward station x_fwd_max = x_p - margin ; block A (1 mm epoxy bond since D-47) gets no crush credit ; crush-stack station (A3/A1 nose stack blk_min from the pod LE) x_stack = x_le + blk_min + L_pack/2, stack margin = x_stack - x_fwd_max ; extension = max(0, -worst margin) ; box x slack = box_x - 2 wall - (envelope_x + extension)
